restrictions: Two distinct 128-byte one-block messages m(a), m(b) of sha3-256-r23-prefix-v1 (zero state, rate 136, suffix 0x06 with pad10*1, rounds 0 to 22, full 256-bit digest). m(u) places the point u (lanes u0..u3) in lanes 1, 6, 11 = u0, u1, u0^u1^K11 and 4, 9, 14 = u2, u3, u2^u3^K14, the other lanes 0..15 fixed constants K (proof.md Section 2); m is injective. F(u) = digest of m(u) xor a fixed mask PD; F(a) = F(b) with a != b is an ordinary collision. Round 0 and round-1 theta are affine in u (a Guo-Liu-Song 2016 linear structure).

Distinguished-point parallel collision search (van Oorschot-Wiener) on F with 256 walks per step: DP = 114 top bits of F zero, cap Lc = 17 x 2^114 - 2 steps, at most 17,540 trails, a table of 5,847 words of three 85-bit records each (69-bit key of the end, used bit, 15-bit trail number; no length field; linear probing over words), the length of a matched trail rebuilt by replaying it to its first DP, Tb = 16965265 x 2^96 steps, a prefilter-hit counter that aborts the attempt at hit HMAX + 1 (HMAX = floor(Tb (1 + 2^-20)/2^8) + 1 + Lc), one replay with a looped one-walk program of F of 5,313 operations (proof.md Section 4).

Machine (declared heuristic H_machine): a register file of 1,024 words of 256 bits (1,018 for program values, 6 for the loop state), every load, store and register move is an instruction charged as one word operation, code counted at 32 bytes per instruction, no compact encoding and no interpreter. One step of 256 walks is 173,426 operations: sections AFF 3,090, GB 7,871 (run eleven times) and GA 8,298 (run ten times), shared code, R22 701, with 31,535 loads, stores and moves of the allocation, plus loop 54, prefilter 17, counter 3 (Section 3).

Cost model collision-frontier-v5, unit 6233 (the organizer reference operation cost of sha3-256-r23, counted by its trusted counter): N = Tb x 173,426 + (3 x 5,313 + 37) x Lc + R + PRE = 238821448428367962182264595463999149945349 word operations, every loop-control, test, transfer and handler operation counted, the rebuild, advance and lock-step of the replay at most Lc evaluations each, at most HMAX + 1 prefilter hits at 207 each in every execution (Section 4); time_log2 = 124.84928 = log2(N/6233) rounded up, integer certificate 6233^100000 2^12484927 < N^100000 <= 6233^100000 2^12484928 (Appendix A).

Preprocessing, run by the attack and charged in N: the constant-selection run gen 512 (512 candidate constant sets, Appendix C), 513 x 2^32 + 512 x 2^10 operations, and the generator gen_s23ls (Appendix B), which selects the polarity pattern over all 2^25 patterns and the boundary size over 7 sizes and writes the program, 2^34 operations (measured 2^33.85 executed instructions); PRE = 2,220,498,616,320, preprocessing_log2 29. No advice.

Memory at most 1,036,480 bytes <= 2^20 (register file, program code at 32 bytes per instruction, other code with the looped replay F, spill cells, the table of 5,847 words, walk state; the search needs 1,036,480 bytes; Section 6). The two preprocessing programs run before the search: measured peaks (VmHWM, whole static image counted) 552,960 bytes for gen 512 and at most 1,032,192 bytes for gen_s23ls including the code region it writes; both also fit a 1 MiB sandbox that counts the declared span. memory_log2_bytes = 20, so normalizedTimeMemoryLog2 = 124.84928 + max(0, 20 - 20) = 124.84928; the Python experiments are reduced-width evidence, not the attack.

Success at least 0.39 for one attempt over the fresh word rho, under the score-critical premise H_rand, an assumption and not a proof: over the algorithm's coins (the random word rho), the program run on the fixed SHA3-256 target succeeds with probability at least the probability computed in proof.md Section 5 for a uniformly random function F, with failure terms for cut trails, the trail limit, self-coincidence, starts on trails and 69-bit key matches of different ends, and the hit-counter abort F5 < 2^-1000 proved by a Chernoff bound (Section 5). No full-scale run and no full collision is claimed.

heuristics.statement: Premise H_rand (an assumption, not proved): over the algorithm's coins, the program run on the fixed SHA3-256-r23 target (F(u) = SHA3-256-r23(m(u)) xor PD, with the linear-structure message embedding m of proof.md Section 2) succeeds with probability at least the probability computed in proof.md Section 5 for a uniformly random function F from 256-bit values to 256-bit values. The only coin of the algorithm is the uniform word rho; the target is fixed, and given rho the run is deterministic, so no hazard of 2^-256 per fresh evaluation is claimed for the fixed target. The computation of Section 5 is made in the random-function model, where F is realised by lazy sampling (values at distinct inputs independent and uniform, a fresh point a distinguished point with probability 2^-114, the remaining length of a trail after a coincidence geometric with parameter 2^-114) and, by construction of that model, given the whole history a fresh evaluation equals one given earlier output with probability 2^-256 whatever inputs the adaptive program chooses; there the first image coincidence among e evaluations has probability at least 1 - exp(-e(e-1)/2^257), and one attempt succeeds with probability at least 0.39 after the failure terms of proof.md Section 5. The premise is that the fixed target carries this probability over.
heuristics.scope: The fixed function F (the 23-round permutation) of proof.md Section 2 on the points of one attempt: at most 1.011209 x 2^128 evaluations in 256 lockstep walks from starts rho + i, i < 17,540. Only the pair-coincidence rate among evaluated images and the distinguished-point rate enter the bound. The step program, the cost, the memory and the failure terms are derived, not assumed.
heuristics.extrapolation: Not statistical. The organizer-executed experiments are program checks, not estimates: rho-w22 runs the whole search with the claimed program at width 22 and each trial runs one attempt and returns a 22-bit partial collision the organizer recomputes, or nulls when the attempt halts at a failed replay or a budget (Section 4); proj-w256 runs eight chained full-width steps and returns the first 22-bit agreement among the 2,048 iterates, recomputed by the organizer. No count, step mean or timing from them (or from our local runs) is used as evidence for H_rand, and no claim is made that the public seeds are unselected or representative. H_rand at 256-bit coincidences and 2^128 evaluations is an assumption, extrapolated from structure and from nothing measured at that scale.
heuristics.limitations: An assumption, not proved: no proof is known that the fixed target behaves like a random function over rho, and the success probability for the fixed target is not established by any argument in this package (the lazy-sampling hazard holds only in the random-function model). The affine round 0 leaves 22 nonlinear rounds; a structural deviation of the collision rate at 256 bits that does not appear in the projections is not excluded. If the pair-coincidence rate is (1 - eps) of uniform, the same success costs about 0.5 log2(1/(1 - eps)) more bits (0.0073 for eps = 0.01).

heuristics.statement: Machine convention: the 256-bit word RAM of collision-frontier-v5 with a declared register file of 1,024 words of 256 bits (1,018 hold program values, 6 the loop state), counted as memory (32,768 bytes). Every load, store and register-to-register move is an instruction and is charged as one word operation in every routine; no memory word is read or written except by a charged load or store. All code is counted at 32 bytes per instruction; there is no compact encoding, interpreter or decode convention (proof.md Section 3.2). The cost model and the target profile fix no register count and no code encoding.
heuristics.scope: The machine that runs the step program and the search of proof.md Section 4; it fixes the time and memory ledgers, not the success bound.
heuristics.extrapolation: None statistical: a declared convention. It is the convention of our blake3-r3 entry 0a9640ed (passed review) and of our sha3-256 entries aa2e6be6, 3183c941 and its full-round port 606bcba0. Every transfer the program needs is written in the program (31,535 loads, stores and moves per step) and counted; the executed checks validate the function of this program, not the cost of register access, and the counts are those of the generated listing (Appendix B). The unit 6233 is the organizer reference operation cost of sha3-256-r23.
heuristics.limitations: A declared convention, not a measured property of hardware. The role supporting is the role of a declared convention and does not mean the choice is free: a smaller register file or another code encoding changes the time and memory ledgers and leaves the success argument unaffected.
